meta.name: slime-rl-training
meta.description: Provides guidance for LLM post-training with RL using slime, a Megatron+SGLang framework. Use when training GLM models, implementing custom data generation workflows, or needing tight Megatron-LM integration for RL scaling.

copy.tagline: 用强化学习对GLM模型进行后训练
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用Megatron框架做LLM的RL后训练
copy.tagline_en: Post-train GLM models with reinforcement learning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing RL post-training on LLMs with Megatron

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能指导你使用 slime 框架对 GLM、Qwen、DeepSeek 等大模型进行强化学习后训练，包括数据准备、训练启动、参数配置和问题排查。
howto.when: 当你需要训练 GLM、Qwen3、DeepSeek V3 或 Llama 3 模型，或需要自定义数据生成流程、紧密集成 Megatron-LM 进行强化学习扩展时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 slime 框架对 Qwen3-4B 模型进行 GRPO 训练。
say.note: 会引导你完成数据准备和训练命令配置。

say.text: slime 训练时遇到 SGLang 引擎崩溃怎么办？
say.note: 会给出启用容错、增加内存分配等解决方案。

say.text: 如何为 slime 训练准备 JSONL 格式的数据？
say.note: 会展示数据格式示例和字段说明。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through using the slime framework for RL post-training of large models like GLM, Qwen, DeepSeek, and Llama 3, covering data preparation, training launch, parameter configuration, and troubleshooting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to train GLM, Qwen3, DeepSeek V3, or Llama 3 models, or when you need custom data generation workflows or tight Megatron-LM integration for RL scaling.

say_en.text: Help me run GRPO training on Qwen3-4B using the slime framework.
say_en.note: Guides you through data prep and training command setup.

say_en.text: What should I do if the SGLang engine crashes during slime training?
say_en.note: Provides solutions like enabling fault tolerance or increasing memory.

say_en.text: How do I prepare JSONL data for slime training?
say_en.note: Shows data format examples and field descriptions.
